what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Türkiye in Greece: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1081 Turkish asylum seekers in Greece, 0.9% of all asylum seekers from Türkiye.
Refugees from Türkiye, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey with the PKK in periods from 1995 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2017 and over the government in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 350 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5185, at the end of 2019; the main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Greece.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Greece only.
